spec_class.notes: First variant in this geometric/circular spec class. The architecture directly exploits the algebraic structure of modular addition via torus rotations. Class is EXPLORING — one data point cannot determine exhaustion.

strategic_notes: Exceptionally strong first ACCEPTed variant. The torus_rotation_compositor achieves 99.94% test accuracy with 353 parameters versus the baseline's 45.32% with 405,023 parameters — a 2,531x improvement in parameter efficiency per accuracy point, and 3,443x fewer FLOPs. The architecture exploits the mathematical structure of modular addition directly: frequency-domain circular embeddings and rotation composition map the problem's group structure into the model's geometry. Fast monotonic convergence (99% at epoch 500, 5% of budget) with no grokking dynamics. Per-prime uniformity is 5.8x tighter than baseline (std dev 0.013 vs 0.076). Late perturbation at epochs 7600-8600 self-resolved. This initializes the Pareto front and establishes the geometric/circular spec class as a high-value search direction.
